item.title: Five Activities for a Rainy Day
item.description: Many people live in or visit the Berkshires for access to stunning outdoor space. The region is a treasure trove for hikers, kayakers, fishers, skiers, birders, campers and more. item.title: Six Spots for Live Music
item.description: If you’re reading this, you’ve probably already been to Tanglewood or experienced Berkshire Busk in Great Barrington. Berkshire County has been drawing music legends to its rolling hills for decades: James Taylor just played his 50th anniversary shows at Tanglewood on July 3 and 4! We’re here to share a handful of spots you can check out for a chill night in the mountains. item.title: A Produce Picking Guide for All Seasons
item.description: Berkshire County is home to nearly 500 farms across 58,000 acres. item.title: New Business Spotlight: Boba Train
item.description: Spots for Bubble Tea are few and far between in Berkshire County. Here at BerkshiresBFF, we are big tea lovers, which is why we were so excited when Liliana Arteaga opened Boba Train in Great Barrington in Fall 2024! With an extensive specialty drinks menu, fresh baked goods and gifts, Boba Train is a great place for coffee with a pal or a sweet afternoon pick-me-up.
